flags.why: This word for earrings is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese.
Calling a group ô hợp disparages its members as a rabble rather than neutrally describing its organisation.
Chiếc thuyền nhỏ bị chìm xuồng unnaturally repeats the boat as both the subject and part of the predicate.
flags.fix: Sóng to làm chìm xuồng. = The big waves sank the small boat.

flags.why: Chìm describes sinking, whereas capsize describes overturning and does not necessarily imply sinking.
flags.fix: The big waves made the little boat sink.

flags.why: Describing hopes as viển vông is an ordinary current use, consistent with the dictionary's unmarked sense of being unrealizable ([Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/vi%E1%BB%83n_v%C3%B4ng)).
Chờ đợi những hy vọng unnaturally means waiting for hopes rather than holding them.
flags.fix: Đừng nuôi những hy vọng viển vông. = Don't harbour unrealistic hopes.

flags.why: A learner today is more likely to encounter the disparaging adjective than the dated name for cholera.
flags.fix: Place current sense 2 first, followed by current sense 1, then senses 3 and 4.
